pages.title: Choose Your Bottle
pages.text: Wine can be served in clear or green stained glass bottles. The choice changes its appearance, not the wine's effects.$(br2)Use either empty bottle on a $(l:cellar/ferment_barrel)Fermentation Barrel$() containing a finished drink to fill it.

pages.title: Clear Glass
pages.text: Use a vanilla Glass Bottle for clear wine bottles. Filled clear bottles appear in 2D in your inventory and hand, and in 3D on Cork Coasters.$(br2)Drinking returns a vanilla Glass Bottle.

pages.title: Stained Glass
pages.text: Three Green Stained Glass blocks in a V shape make three Stained Glass Bottles. Fill them at a Fermentation Barrel.

pages.title: Green Wine Bottles
pages.text: Filled stained bottles retain their green 3D appearance. Drinking returns an empty Stained Glass Bottle.$(br2)Stained bottles fill from Fermentation Barrels; they cannot collect water like vanilla Glass Bottles.

pages.title: Display Your Wine
pages.text: Both filled wine bottle types can be displayed on Cork Coasters.$(br2)Use a filled bottle on an empty coaster to place it. Use an empty hand to retrieve it. The bottle keeps its wine and effects.
